portfolio.statement: SBI Large Cap Fund is heavily concentrated in Financials (36.6%) and Industrials (14.1%), leaving portfolio performance tied closely to rate-sensitive lenders and infrastructure players.
interp: Over the last 3 months, the fund delivered a return of -3.73%, primarily driven lower by top banking positions HDFC Bank (-7.62%), ICICI Bank (-4.37%), and SBI (-5.97%).
Strong gains in Divi's Laboratories (+43.29%) and Samvardhana Motherson (+9.23%) served as the primary performance cushions against broad heavy-industry weakness.
portfolio.line: Heavy banking exposure pulled 3-month returns into negative territory despite outsized single-stock gains in Healthcare and Auto Components.

drivers.text: Divi's Laboratories added an estimated 1.511% to portfolio return on the back of a 43.29% rally and 41% operating margin in Jun 2026 [S88].
HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank together detracted 0.971% over 3 months amid leadership succession reviews and sector headwinds [S3, S7, S9, S46].
Larsen & Toubro declined 8.07% over 3 months, detracting 0.438% despite securing new domestic project awards [S13, S48, S49, S52].

macro.why: With 36.6% of assets in Financials, fund returns are sensitive to lending margins, regulatory adjustments, and banking governance shifts.
Industrial and material allocations depend heavily on domestic plant investments and corporate order inflows.

Asian Paints completed construction and commenced captive production at its 150,000 tpa Dahej VAE plant [S85].
